NightSwipe.description: Stuck trying to make plans with your friends? Let NightSwipe take the pressure off! Simply join a group, swipe on restaurants, events, and attractions, and let NightSwipe’s smart algorithm handle the rest. In minutes, you’ll have a personalized itinerary full of food, fun, and places to explore that everyone will love.

design.description: NightSwipe’s design went through a few cycles before it came time to implement. After our initial proposal, we started to jot down ideas on sticky notes before drawing screens out on printer paper. After we solidified what screens we wanted to create, we drafted a prototype in Adobe Illustrator which gave us a feel for the fonts and color palettes we would be using in the final design.

implementation.description: We Implemented our design for iOS in Swift, utilizing a Firebase backend to store basic user information and curate the itinerary to be displayed on the frontend. To gather restaurant and entertainment venue details, we used a Yelp API. To collaborate on this project, we used GitHub and followed an Agile development cycle. Throughout development, we regularly demonstrated our work to peers and stakeholders and performed user studies to assist in determining necessary improvements.

images.name: tech_stack.png
images.description: Our stack consisted of a Swift frontend, utilizing a Firebase backend and Yelp API.

images.name: ./assets/project_images/nightswipe/implementation/style_guide.png
images.description: An important aspect of implementation was that everyone had a strong grasp of the app's style during development. I created functions for commonly used items with guidelines for how to use them in this style guide.

result.description: We were able to create an application that flowed well, looked good, and, most of all, worked! The app was well received by its users and we plan to continue development into the future!

Infinite Library.description: Follow Alex, keeper of the Infinite Library as she wards off the mysterious force that threatens the birthplace of all knowledge. Tight platforming and curious puzzles abound as you traverse the library and discover the powers of books strewn about. Uncover the mysteries of the library and help Alex save the Library!

design.description: The inspiration for this game came from the mind of Samantha Braswell who drew this beautiful illustration that set the tone for the entire project. What lay within the walls of this mysterious library?

images.name: inspiration.png
images.description: From the mind of Samantha Braswell

implementation.description: Implentation took place largely in Unreal Engine. Assets were designed in 3D modeling software like Blender and Maya while 2D textures and UI elements were designed in Illustrator.

images.name: unreal.png
images.description: Infinite Library was created largely in Unreal

result.description: My main contributions to this project are held within the UI/UX panels of the game. I created UI elements in Illustrator that I implemented in Unreal Engine. Thanks to the hard work and dedication of all seven members of our team, we were awarded Best in Game Design at Texas A&M’s Viz-A-Go-Go event!
